title: The Nihilist Reading Of The Betrayal Knows My Name #Shorts
description:
The feeling that The Betrayal Knows My Name means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. The Betrayal Knows My Name (Japanese: 裏切りは僕の名前を知っている, Hepburn: Uragiri wa Boku no Namae o Shitteiru) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Odagiri Hotaru. It was serialized in Kadokawa Shoten's shōjo manga magazine Monthly Asuka between October 2005 and June 2017.

What culture calls destiny in The Betrayal Knows My Name is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. After Kuroto was reincarnated and put into the custody of Senshirou's grandfather for Zweilt training, Cadenza returned to kill Kuroto. The old man died protecting Senshirou and Kuroto, who both now want Cadenza dead.
